id.description: A UNIQUE identifier for this Source/Client

blacklistDevices.description: DO NOT scrobble from any cast devices on this list that START WITH these values

whitelistDevices.description: ONLY scrobble from any cast device on this list that START WITH these values

blacklistApps.description: DO NOT scrobble from any application on this list that START WITH these values

whitelistApps.description: ONLY scrobble from any application on this list that START WITH these values

useAvahi.description: Try to use Avahi and avahi-browse to resolve mDNS devices instead of native mDNS querying

useAutoDiscovery.description: Use mDNS to discovery Google Cast devices on your next automatically?

devices.description: A list of Google Cast devices to monitor

name.description: A friendly name to identify this device

address.description: The IP address of the device

allowUnknownMedia.description: Chromecast Apps report a "media type" in the status info returned for whatever is currently playing

forceMediaRecognitionOn.description: Media provided by any App whose name is listed here will ALWAYS be tracked, regardless of the "media type" reported

enable.description: Should MS parse this config and create a client/source from it?

clients.description: Restrict scrobbling tracks played from this Source to Clients with IDs from this list.

autoMonitor.description: Set the default behavior for wether this component should automatically monitor any activity, or scrobble, it encounters

maxRequestRetries.description:
default # of http **request** retries a source/client can make before error is thrown
a test

retryMultiplier.description: default retry delay multiplier (retry attempt * multiplier = # of seconds to wait before retrying)

maxPollRetries.description: default # of automatic polling restarts on error

logPayload.description: If this source has INGRESS to MS (sends a payload, rather than MS GETTING requesting a payload) then setting this option to true will make MS log the payload JSON to DEBUG output

logFilterFailure.description: If this source has INGRESS to MS and has filters this determines how MS logs when a payload (event) fails a defined filter (IE users/servers/library filters)

logPlayerState.description: For Sources that track Player State (currently playing) this logs a simple player state/summary to DEBUG output

logToFile.description: **Exprimental:** Log to a separate file for this Source.

scrobbleThresholds.description: Set thresholds for when multi-scrobbler should consider a tracked play to be "scrobbable".

duration.description: The number of seconds a track has been listened to before it should be considered scrobbled.

percent.description: The percentage (as an integer) of a track that should have been seen played before it should be scrobbled.

scrobbleBacklogCount.description: The number of listens to fetch when scrobbling from backlog

preCompare.description: Stages to be applied when a Play is first seen by this component
